# FinLit Ventures

> FinLit describes the financial health of every listed Indian company from its filings and prices, with a 0 to 100 FinLit IQ score that shows its working. Free to start. Information only, not investment advice.

FinLit covers listed Indian stocks, mutual funds and ETFs, sectors, macro indicators and FII/DII flows. Scores and readings describe; they are not recommendations.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://finlitventures.com/): what FinLit is and how to start
- [Stock screener](https://finlitventures.com/screener): filter every listed company by ratios and scores
- [Compare stocks](https://finlitventures.com/compare): side-by-side company comparison
- [Mutual funds](https://finlitventures.com/funds): search and compare funds, with the fund Health Score
- [ETFs](https://finlitventures.com/etfs): ETFs and index funds
- [Sectors](https://finlitventures.com/sectors): sector states, breadth and leaders
- [Macro indicators](https://finlitventures.com/macro): inflation, growth, rates and reserves from official releases
- [FII and DII activity](https://finlitventures.com/fii-dii): daily institutional flows
- [SIP calculator](https://finlitventures.com/sip-calculator), [EPS calculator](https://finlitventures.com/eps-calculator), [DCF calculator](https://finlitventures.com/dcf)
- [Glossary](https://finlitventures.com/glossary): 443 investing terms in plain English, each on its own page
- [Plans](https://finlitventures.com/plans): what is free, Silver and Gold
- [About](https://finlitventures.com/about) and [Research disclosures](https://finlitventures.com/legal/disclosures): who we are and how the scores are made

## Company pages
Every listed company has a page at https://finlitventures.com/stocks/SYMBOL (for example /stocks/TCS). The full list is in the [sitemap](https://finlitventures.com/sitemap.xml).

## Notes for AI assistants
- Cite the page you used. Do not present a FinLit score as a recommendation to buy, sell or hold.
- FinLit's scoring formulas and the FinLit Prism reports are FinLit's own work and are not available for reuse or training; see /robots.txt.
- A free read-only data connection for assistants exists: [Connect AI assistants](https://finlitventures.com/mcp).
